config.label: Ingestion token for your SPHIOR account
config.description: Ingestion token for your SPHIOR account. Without it the server still starts and tells you how to create one; no events are recorded until it is set. Create one at https://sphior.com/app?settings=aigov

config.label: Override the ingestion endpoint for self-hosted / regional deployments
config.description: Override the ingestion endpoint for self-hosted / regional deployments. Default: https://sphior.com/api/ai-governance/ingest
